simpleJp: 9/26 【受注・時間なし】王都の終盤依頼と賞金首を確認する
enGuide: September 26 time-free QUEST INTAKE only, NOT an independent daytime action. Grand Trad quest board/new side quests can be accepted via conversations. Reserve daytime for Bardon R8 in Martira and evening for Brigitta R8 in Grand Trad; inter-city map teleport/shopping/quest intake should be done without advancing a time period. If a particular request would advance time, postpone it to the first REAL open October slot rather than double-booking Bardon's rank day. Enter final story operation before Oct 25 cutoff.

simpleJp: 9/26 【収集・時間消費なし】黄金蟲27：王都あんしん薬方堂の奥のカウンターを調べる
enGuide: Gold Beetle #27 of 50 — Grand Trad Anshin Apothecary: only after the shop decor shifts, look behind counter (different from the entrance beetle). This is a collectible interaction during the indicated city visit/dungeon, not an extra daytime activity; if you are traveling on a different date collect upon first access. Independent locations: Game8/GameWith, GAMEX and PowerPyx.

simpleJp: 9/26 【収集・時間消費なし】黄金蟲43：マルティラ牛鳴き小道の牛の奥を調べる
enGuide: Gold Beetle #43 of 50 — Martira Cow-crying Alley near man leading cow. If no sparkle, talk to Brilehaven beetle elder first and return. This is a collectible interaction during the indicated city visit/dungeon, not an extra daytime activity; if you are traveling on a different date collect upon first access. Independent locations: Game8/GameWith, GAMEX and PowerPyx.

simpleJp: 9/26 【収集・時間消費なし】黄金蟲44：マルティラ視る視る堂の店主前の袋を調べる
enGuide: Gold Beetle #44 of 50 — Martira Visir shop: examine sack before shopkeeper. May require talking to beetle elder first. This is a collectible interaction during the indicated city visit/dungeon, not an extra daytime activity; if you are traveling on a different date collect upon first access. Independent locations: Game8/GameWith, GAMEX and PowerPyx.

simpleJp: 9/26 【収集・時間消費なし】黄金蟲45：王都レガリス大聖堂前の市場を調べる
enGuide: Gold Beetle #45 of 50 — Grand Trad market outside Regalith Cathedral, beside stall. If unavailable, revisit after talking to beetle collector. This is a collectible interaction during the indicated city visit/dungeon, not an extra daytime activity; if you are traveling on a different date collect upon first access. Independent locations: Game8/GameWith, GAMEX and PowerPyx.

simpleJp: 9/26 【受注・時間なし】王都で『伝説の武器を探せ』を受注する
enGuide: 9/26, 受注・時間なし: From Sept 26 Grand Trad Sunshade Row, accept this quest; follow the indicated Mt Vulkano/deposit retrieval and report to original quest giver after the related late-game dungeon visit. No extra full activity slot is assigned for accepting/reporting quests unless the in-game action actually advances time. Verified Japanese source: GameWith quest table.

simpleJp: 9/26 【報告・時間なし】：錆びついた大剣を王都日陰通りの重装備の男へ渡す
enGuide: Use sword obtained September 18 from Vulcano; accept weapon request first, then deliver for 宿望の大剣. Source https://metaphor.mtwildwood.net/ja/quests/the-edge-of-glory/ .

simpleJp: 9/26 【受注・時間なし】ビルガ島で『英雄たちの墓場』を受注する
enGuide: 9/26, 受注・時間なし: Pick up first dragon trial from Virga Island Dragon Statue Square. Clear its indicated dragon dungeon/battle in the late Sept–Oct routing and return for the relevant dragon-armor reward. No extra full activity slot is assigned for accepting/reporting quests unless the in-game action actually advances time. Verified Japanese source: GameWith quest table.

simpleJp: 9/26 【受注・時間なし】アルタベリーで『前世界の遺産』を受注する
enGuide: 9/26, 受注・時間なし: At Altabury Skybound Bridge, accept second dragon trial. The late dungeon challenge should be grouped with one of the October dragon battles, not a separate arbitrary quest trip. No extra full activity slot is assigned for accepting/reporting quests unless the in-game action actually advances time. Verified Japanese source: GameWith quest table.

simpleJp: 9/26 【受注・時間なし】ブライハーヴェンで『狂竜の悪戯』を受注する
enGuide: 9/26, 受注・時間なし: At Brilehaven Angler's Inn Square accept third dragon trial; collect its quest armor reward after the planned dragon-battle trip. No extra full activity slot is assigned for accepting/reporting quests unless the in-game action actually advances time. Verified Japanese source: GameWith quest table.

simpleJp: 9/26 【受注・時間なし】募兵舎で『終末を祈る狂信者たち』を受注する
enGuide: 9/26, 受注・時間なし: Late bounty from any recruitment centre, available Sept 26. Defeat requested target during the already planned Disgraced Path/late dungeon segment and report to recruitment centre. No extra full activity slot is assigned for accepting/reporting quests unless the in-game action actually advances time. Verified Japanese source: GameWith quest table.

simpleJp: 9/26 【受注・時間なし】募兵舎で『天上に住まう幻の鳥』を受注する
enGuide: 9/26, 受注・時間なし: Late bounty available Sept 26; combine target with the Manor of the Ascendant exploration Sept 29 and return to recruitment centre. No extra full activity slot is assigned for accepting/reporting quests unless the in-game action actually advances time. Verified Japanese source: GameWith quest table.

simpleJp: 9/26 【受注・時間なし】募兵舎で『恨み渦巻く森の化身』を受注する
enGuide: 9/26, 受注・時間なし: Late bounty after Sept 26. Use the quest map to locate the forest target during scheduled optional excursions rather than wasting an unplanned free-time day; report at recruitment centre after victory. No extra full activity slot is assigned for accepting/reporting quests unless the in-game action actually advances time. Verified Japanese source: GameWith quest table.

simpleJp: 9/26 【受注・時間なし】アルタベリーで『温泉の湯を届けろ』を受注する
enGuide: 9/26, 受注・時間なし: Accept at upper Skybound Bridge from polite merchant, collect spring water at Altabury hot spring visit on Oct 3 and report back to merchant to receive Gold Beetle #47. No extra full activity slot is assigned for accepting/reporting quests unless the in-game action actually advances time. Verified Japanese source: GameWith quest table.

simpleJp: 9/26 【受注・時間なし】王都で『さらに料理人を唸らせる一皿を届けろ』を受注する
enGuide: 9/26, 受注・時間なし: Accept second cooking quest in Grand Trad Sunlumeo Street, cook the requested fluffy honey confection while traveling Sept 27, and return to the requester Sept 29. No extra full activity slot is assigned for accepting/reporting quests unless the in-game action actually advances time. Verified Japanese source: GameWith quest table.

simpleJp: 9/26 【購入・時間なし】レガリス大聖堂前でアルタベリー麦粉4を購入する
enGuide: Confirm missing base recipes before leaving: 3 legendary fish total including chef reward, 5 honey jars, 5 mushrooms. If short, reserve October recovery travel; do not repeat cooked recipes until all 21 are done.

simpleJp: 9/26 昼：9/26以降、昼のマルティラでバードンと話す
enGuide: Calendar 9/26 昼. Bardon R8: After the level-60 Great Sandworm fight at R7, return from September 26 onward to Martira's Thoroughfare Square in DAYTIME and speak to Bardon for his final Commander bond.

simpleJp: 9/26 夜：9/26以降、夜の王都でベルギッタと話す
enGuide: Calendar 9/26 夜. Brigitta R8: From the September 26 story transition onward, return to Grand Trad's Sunlumeo Street at NIGHT and speak with Brigitta. Her earlier Courage-4 R7 must already be finished. This is a hard earliest-availability gate, not a fixed September 26 appointment.

simpleJp: 9/27 昼・旅行：見捨てられた道へ向けて出発する
enGuide: Depart on the actual Runner journey; buy the spider thread at Malva for the winter-clothing quest en route.

simpleJp: 9/27 昼・鎧戦車【時短料理・時間なし】：魔性華麗鍋を作る
enGuide: Recipe 18/21. アルタベリー麦粉1・怪獣骨2・伝説のヌシ1. Eupha joined. Cook before the consuming activity, once in this half-day only; Maria R4 removes clock cost. Mark the distinct recipe cooked. Recipe tables: https://gamers-high.com/metaphor-rf/data/cooking.html ; https://game8.jp/metaphor-re-fantazio/646815 . Date follows the GamerB written calendar.

simpleJp: 9/27 昼・鎧戦車：『よみ・かき・おてほん』を読了する
enGuide: Use the daytime activity after free cooking.

simpleJp: 9/27 夜・鎧戦車【時短料理・時間なし】：ふわふわ蜜菓子を作る
enGuide: Recipe 19/21: 白桃かぶ2・アルタベリー麦粉2・トウ蜜蜂2. Basilio joined. Reserve a portion for September 29 chef. Then read 魔法的未来 as the night's single consuming activity.

simpleJp: 9/28 昼・鎧戦車【時短料理・時間なし】：かちこち蜜菓子を作る
enGuide: Recipe 20/21. アルタベリー麦粉1・女帝蜂の蜜瓶1・オルゴ糖2. Basilio joined. Cook before the consuming activity, once in this half-day only; Maria R4 removes clock cost. Mark the distinct recipe cooked. Recipe tables: https://gamers-high.com/metaphor-rf/data/cooking.html ; https://game8.jp/metaphor-re-fantazio/646815 . Date follows the GamerB written calendar.

simpleJp: 9/28 昼・鎧戦車：見捨てられた道に入る前に『魔法的未来』を読む
enGuide: Read on the moving Runner before the dungeon, not after returning to town.

simpleJp: 9/28 昼・攻略：見捨てられた道で『恨み渦巻く森の化身』の賞金首を倒す
enGuide: Explore dungeon, collect beetle, kill bounty and buy 丈夫な蜘蛛糸 in Malva on the journey. Return to recruitment centre on September 29 to report. No arbitrary extra dungeon.

simpleJp: 9/28 【収集・時間消費なし】黄金蟲50：見捨てられた道の最北端の採集を調べる
enGuide: Gold Beetle #50 of 50 — Disgraced Path: northernmost glowing point. This is a collectible interaction during the indicated city visit/dungeon, not an extra daytime activity; if you are traveling on a different date collect upon first access. Independent locations: Game8/GameWith, GAMEX and PowerPyx.

simpleJp: 9/29 【報告・時間なし】：王都の料理人にふわふわ蜜菓子を渡す
enGuide: Chef on Sunlumeo Street gives legendary fish; save it for final recipe. Report Forsaken Tower bounty at recruitment centre before next departure.

simpleJp: 9/29 昼・旅行：天上人の邸へ向けて出発する
enGuide: After turning in the sweets and receiving the legendary fish, depart on the Runner before making the final recipe.

simpleJp: 9/29 昼・鎧戦車【作成前確認・時間なし】：料理20種の作成印とガイセン茸3・女帝蜂の蜜瓶3・伝説のヌシ1を確認する
enGuide: Check the in-game recipe marks, not possession of food. If even one base recipe or ingredient is missing, skip today's final recipe and follow the dedicated October 14–16 sea trip; do not spend these reserved materials on repeat recipes. If mushrooms alone are missing, save outside today's pantry and reload until the day's one collection yields a shroom; use each remaining free town day's pantry before departure. Sources GameWith 468448 and Game8 646807.

simpleJp: 9/29 昼・鎧戦車【時短料理・時間なし】：至高のひと匙を作る
enGuide: Recipe 21/21. 伝説のヌシ1・女帝蜂の蜜瓶3・ガイセン茸3. Only after all 20 base recipes have been cooked; if missing use October recovery slots before final audit. Cook before the consuming activity, once in this half-day only; Maria R4 removes clock cost. Mark the distinct recipe cooked. Recipe tables: https://gamers-high.com/metaphor-rf/data/cooking.html ; https://game8.jp/metaphor-re-fantazio/646815 . Date follows the GamerB written calendar. If this step cannot be performed, follow the dated October 14–16 recovery steps below; do not advance the achievement check as complete.

simpleJp: 9/29 昼・鎧戦車：天上人の邸に入る前に『魔法的未来』を読み、見識5を目指す
enGuide: Use the daytime reading slot after free cooking and before entering the dungeon.

simpleJp: 9/29 昼・攻略：天上人の邸で『天上に住まう幻の鳥』の賞金首を倒す
enGuide: Cook and read before dungeon entry; loot beetle and defeat target. Report at recruitment centre on September 30.

simpleJp: 9/29 【収集・時間消費なし】黄金蟲49：天上人の邸2階の梁を渡って壁穴を探す
enGuide: Gold Beetle #49 of 50 — Manor of Ascendant 2F: cross beam over missing floor, then pass through west wall hole. This is a collectible interaction during the indicated city visit/dungeon, not an extra daytime activity; if you are traveling on a different date collect upon first access. Independent locations: Game8/GameWith, GAMEX and PowerPyx.

simpleJp: 9/30 【報告・時間なし】：蜘蛛糸をアルタベリーの依頼人へ、賞金首を募兵舎へ報告する
enGuide: Deliver 丈夫な蜘蛛糸 bought at Malva to the winter-clothing requester on Dia Franco Street lower level; report Heavenly bird bounty. Teleport to visited towns before Basilio appointment.

simpleJp: 9/30 昼：想像力5を得て昼のバジリオと話す
enGuide: Calendar 9/30 昼. TRANSFERRED from September window to final month; date and free slot must be assigned before review. Basilio R6: Requires the MAX Imagination (想像力) rank 5 and the normal cooldown after R5. Talk to Basilio during the day in a town hub; skipping Virtue training here blocks his chain.

simpleJp: 9/30 夜：2日後、夜のブライハーヴェンでダチュラムと話す
enGuide: Calendar 9/30 夜. TRANSFERRED from September window to final month; date and free slot must be assigned before review. Alonzo R8: Two days after R7, do NOT hunt for the usual Alonzo icon: talk to Daturam (ダチュラム) at Brilehaven Angler's Inn Square at night and follow the conclusion of 'A Rake's Last Wish' (アロンゾの遺志を叶えろ). The alternate NPC is required to finish his Faker bond.

simpleJp: 10/1 昼：ハイペリック討伐済み・見識5でユーファと話してランク7
enGuide: Hyperic was defeated September 18; don't repeat the dungeon here.

simpleJp: 10/1 夜：ジュナのランク7から2日後、夜の鎧戦車で話す
enGuide: Calendar 10/1 夜. TRANSFERRED from September window to final month; date and free slot must be assigned before review. Junah R8: Again at night in the Runner's central passage, two days after R7. Once completed, Masked Dancer's final bond effects unlock.

simpleJp: 10/2 昼：バジリオのランク6から2日後、昼に街で話す
enGuide: Calendar 10/2 昼. TRANSFERRED from September window to final month; date and free slot must be assigned before review. Basilio R7: Two days after R6, talk to him in daytime in an available town hub. R8 adds MAX Eloquence 5 plus a special brother-related battle request; prepare that before the endgame.

simpleJp: 10/2 夜：キャゼリナのランク7から2日後、夜のアルタベリーで話す
jpGuide1: 夜にキャゼリナと会話
enGuide: Calendar 10/2 夜. Catherina R8: After the ordinary two-day cooldown from R7, talk with her at NIGHT on Altabury's Skybound Bridge. If the event did not appear earlier, try again after the September 26 story transition. Her first four ranks (cathedral and three Gauntlet Runner encounters) must have been completed.

simpleJp: 10/3 昼・闘技場：闘技場の金2級戦に勝つ
enGuide: Calendar 10/3 昼・闘技場. Complete this Coliseum tier for optional first-run achievement/completion; if the arena remains closed, fulfill its prior rank entry requirements.

simpleJp: 10/3 夜・観光：アルタベリーの蒼穹橋下層の温泉に入る
enGuide: Calendar 10/3 夜・観光. Optional scenic/hot-spring content on an otherwise free evening. Replace with overdue rank gates if needed.

simpleJp: 10/4 【収集・時間消費なし】黄金蟲47：アルタベリー温泉の湯の依頼を報告する
enGuide: Gold Beetle #47 of 50 — Golden Beetle from '温泉の湯を届けろ'; obtain the hot spring water and report to the polite merchant on Altabury upper Skybound Bridge. The beetle is awarded by quest turn-in. This is a collectible interaction during the indicated city visit/dungeon, not an extra daytime activity; if you are traveling on a different date collect upon first access. Independent locations: Game8/GameWith, GAMEX and PowerPyx. Report after the previous evening's hot spring visit, before the daytime follower event.

simpleJp: 10/4 昼・依頼：説得力5でバジリオのビンカ討伐依頼を達成する
jpGuide1: 暴走するビンカを止めろ
jpGuide2: 暴走するビンカを止めろ
enGuide: Calendar 10/4 昼・依頼. Basilio R8: Requires MAX Eloquence (説得力) 5 and two days after R7. Talk to him during the DAY, accept 'A Brother's Mercy' (暴走するビンカを止めろ), travel to the indicated quest location, defeat Vinca WITH Basilio participating in the party, and finish the follow-up bond scene. Do not stop at R7 or skip the battle.

simpleJp: 10/4 夜・資質：マルティラで勇気を鍛える
enGuide: Calendar 10/4 夜・資質. If Courage is still below 5, use a town Courage activity. This is a flexible spare activity once all urgent ranks are covered.

simpleJp: 10/5 昼・旅行：ミロの鎧戦車へ向かう途中、ユーファと話してランク8
enGuide: One travel-only daytime event, then complete the encounter; do not duplicate the rank.

simpleJp: 10/5 夜：バルマレーノ闘技場の金1級戦を終える
enGuide: Dated reference reserves this arena event; after the Runner encounter return to Brilehaven via town teleport when available.

simpleJp: 10/6 昼・攻略：不詳の遺跡で『終末を祈る狂信者たち』の賞金首を倒す
enGuide: Defeat the bounty, collect the beetle and report at recruitment centre on October 7.

simpleJp: 10/6 【収集・時間消費なし】黄金蟲46：不詳の遺跡入口最初の分岐の左端を調べる
enGuide: Gold Beetle #46 of 50 — Unproven Ruins: left at initial fork, search at the dead end. This is a collectible interaction during the indicated city visit/dungeon, not an extra daytime activity; if you are traveling on a different date collect upon first access. Independent locations: Game8/GameWith, GAMEX and PowerPyx.

simpleJp: 10/7 【報告・時間なし】：募兵舎で不詳の遺跡の賞金首を報告する
enGuide: Finish bounty before main dungeon departure.

simpleJp: 10/7 昼・攻略：天の巨顔の依頼を進める
enGuide: Calendar 10/7 昼・攻略. Complete the Skybound Avatar/Sky Face objective as the reference route allows. Maintain pre-final-story quest progress; gather loot before leaving.

simpleJp: 10/8 昼・闘技場：闘技場の王者戦を終える
enGuide: Calendar 10/8 昼・闘技場. Coliseum Champion-level battle; make sure you reset your usual party setup afterward.

simpleJp: 10/8 夜・闘技場：闘技場の上級連戦を終える
enGuide: Calendar 10/8 夜・闘技場. Finish Coliseum Advanced Gauntlet optional completion if prepared. Can be postponed into free October buffer.

simpleJp: 10/9 昼・攻略：邪見の塔の竜の試練を終える
enGuide: Calendar 10/9 昼・攻略. Late dragon trial: prepare elemental resistances/dispels according to quest intel, clear the Tower of Insolence challenge, and report quest reward. This is a later high-level trip, different from the early tower bounty.

simpleJp: 10/10 【アカデメイア・時間なし】：特別実験で全ての依り代を作成する
enGuide: Speak to More and open 特別実験 → 召喚獣の特別実験. Use the crafted marks to complete every vessel; buy missing talismans from 力自慢の店主 in Virga's Dragon Statue Square (100,000 reeve each before discounts, limited stock). Unlock any prerequisite archetypes/experiments first. Collect every dungeon pickup and retain enemy drops; repeat the experiment check on Oct 24 and before the last boss. Sources: https://bozumemo.jp/metaphor-refantazio/yorishiro/ ; https://kamigame.jp/metaphor/page/345874317625546702.html .

simpleJp: 10/10 【アカデメイア・時間なし】：ジュナの仮面の特別実験で未作成の仮面を確認し、作れるものを全て作成する
enGuide: More → 特別実験 → 仮面の特別実験. Check the completed mark rather than equipped or held quantity; advanced masks consume earlier masks as ingredients but do not erase the earlier crafted mark. Unlock the source Archetype if a recipe is hidden. Collect needed white masks from dungeon loot and the Brilehaven merchant unlocked Aug 19. For each advanced recipe, craft any missing precursor masks first. Start with the next checklist and finish on Oct 24/26.

simpleJp: 10/10 【仮面チェック1・時間なし】：探求者・魔法探求者・魂探求者／魔術師・賢人・精霊術師・黒魔術師／戦士・剣闘士・侍の仮面を作成する
enGuide: 10 mask entries: Seeker family (3), Mage (4), Warrior (3). For each row read the two ingredients shown in the experiment menu; if it requires earlier masks, create those before the advanced one. Tick only the creation mark. Source lists: https://bozumemo.jp/metaphor-refantazio/mask/ and https://game8.jp/metaphor-re-fantazio/644664 .

simpleJp: 10/10 【仮面チェック2・時間なし】：騎士・魔法騎士・聖騎士・闇騎士／格闘家・師範・拳聖／施療師・聖職者・救世主の仮面を作成する
enGuide: 10 more entries: Knight (4), Brawler (3), Healer (3). If missing base components, purchase only missing white masks on appropriate weekday (Aug 22 instructions). Preserve crafted marks even if a precursor is consumed.

simpleJp: 10/10 【仮面チェック3・時間なし】：砲兵・狙撃兵・竜砲兵／盗賊・暗殺者・忍者／道化・愚者／軍師・知将・名軍師の仮面を作成する
enGuide: 11 more entries: Gunner (3), Thief (3), Faker (2), Commander (3). Unlock all relevant archetypes by progressing the Follower ranks, and use the experiment menu for the exact ingredient deficits.

simpleJp: 10/10 【仮面チェック4・時間なし】：商人・豪商／召喚士・悪魔召喚士／狂戦士・破壊者／舞踏・頑強・魔力・武力・恋愛の仮面を作成する
enGuide: Last 11 entries, 42 total across the four lists. Keep the menu completion marks; some recipes need previous masks or archetype unlocks. If any remain, acquire materials on the remaining town days and complete before final boss. Both all masks AND all vessels are required for 実験終了.

simpleJp: 10/10 昼・攻略：不遜の塔の竜の試練を終える
enGuide: Calendar 10/10 昼・攻略. Complete the late dragon trial at Tower of Ascendant/Arrogance. This is the later revisit, not the September side quest.

simpleJp: 10/11 昼・攻略：盲信の塔の竜の試練を終える
enGuide: Calendar 10/11 昼・攻略. Finish the late dragon trial at Tower of Blind Faith. Collect any remaining objective loot on this revisit.

simpleJp: 10/11 【収集・時間消費なし】黄金蟲48：盲信の塔6階の北側で採集する
enGuide: Gold Beetle #48 of 50 — Tower of Blind Faith 6F: northern glowing gathering point in the room with three tough foes. This is a collectible interaction during the indicated city visit/dungeon, not an extra daytime activity; if you are traveling on a different date collect upon first access. Independent locations: Game8/GameWith, GAMEX and PowerPyx.

simpleJp: 10/12 【出発前・条件解放】：竜の試練3件の達成を確認し『力の神髄』を受ける
enGuide: Check the three trial quests complete before departing. Return for reward after boss if the quest log requires it.

simpleJp: 10/12 昼・攻略：三つの竜の試練報告後、竜宮神殿で『力の神髄』を達成する
enGuide: After all three trials are complete and reported, take the unlocked final trial and defeat its boss at Dragon Temple. The unlock must occur before entering this dungeon.

simpleJp: 10/13 【予備遠征の準備・時間なし】：未作成料理と不足食材を調べ、必要なら釣り餌を用意する
enGuide: Skip the following Oct 14–16 contingency only if all 21 dishes have already been cooked. Count mushrooms still required (one per missing whitefish/sweet dish, three for the final dish), the fish and honey jars still needed. Reroll today's pantry if short. For fish buy cricket/worm bait from Martira insect boy; check Tail Bait and use storage cleaning on the trip if necessary. Buy remaining ordinary ingredients before departing.

simpleJp: 10/13 アカデメイア：25種類のアーキタイプを履修してモアに報告する
jpGuide1: 25種類のアーキタイプを履修する。
enGuide: Calendar 10/13 アカデメイア. FLEXIBLE unslotted prerequisite. Do at another actual free day, not an extra 9/12 slot. More R7: Study at least 25 DISTINCT Archetypes (not simply rank 25 in one class) and report More's 'Determination' research task in Akademia. By now, Junah and Eupha have expanded your class availability.

simpleJp: 10/13 アカデメイア：最上位アーキタイプを1つランク20にしてモアに報告する
jpGuide1: いずれかの最上位アーキタイプをRANK20にする。
jpGuide2: 最上位アーキタイプ」をランク20
enGuide: Calendar October 13, Akademia task report, no ordinary daytime/evening Follower slot. More R8: AFTER More R7's 25-Archetype assignment, study a highest-tier / Elite Archetype and raise that Archetype rank to 20, then report the final Akademia research task to More. The old 'UNSCHEDULED' warning was a stale transfer note and is no longer applicable; if your class leveling is behind, handle it in dungeon grinding before the Oct 25 deadline.

simpleJp: 10/13 監査・時間なし：読書7冊の読了を確認する
enGuide: Calendar 10/13 監査・時間なし. Seven books, three unique sessions each: 新世界旅行記, 頷かせる技術, 在りし日のこと, 魔法的未来 (pick up Julian by August 12), ※秘※詩集※見るな※, 島の外の歩き方, よみ・かき・おてほん. Missing sessions must use real Runner slots.

simpleJp: 10/13 監査・時間なし：黄金蟲を累計46匹以上交換する
enGuide: Calendar 10/13 監査・時間なし. Brilehaven Arenafront Wharf elderly beetle collector gives five cumulative rewards at 1,12,25,38,46. 50 beetles exist. Verify 46 turned in cumulative, not necessarily inventory; critical #1 June 5, #21 toothbrush report by Aug 9, #42 Sept 24.

simpleJp: 10/13 【報告・時間なし】終盤の賞金首とドラゴン試練の依頼を精算する
enGuide: 10/13, 報告・時間なし: Check all outstanding bounties at a recruitment centre and all late quest NPCs in Grand Trad, Brilehaven, Altabury and Virga Island. A quest is not completed until report dialogue when required; verify the log before final 10/25 audit. No extra full activity slot is assigned for accepting/reporting quests unless the in-game action actually advances time. Verified Japanese source: GameWith quest table.

simpleJp: 10/13 【監査・時間なし】：料理21種類の作成済み印と『最強料理人』を確認する
enGuide: If all 21 marks are present, verify 最強料理人. Otherwise follow the actual Oct 14–16 recovery route immediately below; only mark complete on success. This is an initial check, not a terminal audit.

simpleJp: 10/14 昼・予備遠征（料理未完了時のみ）：ビルガ島方面の円環のしるべへ鎧戦車で出発する
enGuide: Conditional recovery on a documented free day (Oct 13–25); at the round table select Circle Landmark for a real sea leg, not town teleport. Both Game8 646721 and Gamers High fishing guide document island-water fishing after the Runner upgrade. Save before pantry, reroll for shroom as needed. Free-cook one missing base dish before fishing; use one ordinary daytime slot on fishing if needed. With Tail Bait, choose the honey response for 1 legendary fish + 2 honey jars, or fish-doubling response for 2 fish. For honey only use worm/cricket bait with honey response. If weather blocks fishing, use a later recovery day; do not assume land travel can fish.

simpleJp: 10/14 夜・予備遠征（必要時のみ）：野営して次の目的地を儀礼の地に設定し、未作成料理を1種作る
enGuide: If no fish/ingredient deficit remains, make one missing base recipe (or the final recipe if all twenty are already marked and enough ingredients remain). If further recovery needed choose camp rather than instant return, and select Ritual Site as the next destination. If Tail Bait is missing, save before cleaning cargo storage, then reload until bait drops; this is the one consuming night activity. If no camping prompt is available because the dungeon was already cleared, return to town and depart the next day instead.

simpleJp: 10/15 昼・予備遠征（必要時のみ）：儀礼の地への海路で食料庫と釣りを利用する
enGuide: Take the real sea route, save/reload before the new daily pantry if short; fish for remaining ingredients in the daytime if needed. Free-cook one missing base recipe in the other half-day if feasible. If the final dish is still blocked, use a further actual sea trip on Oct 16 or subsequent free dates. No second consuming action in the same half-day; weather may force later departure. Do not return to a previously cleared dungeon just to fight it again.

simpleJp: 10/16 昼・予備遠征（必要時のみ）：円環のしるべ方面への鎧戦車移動中に至高のひと匙を作る
enGuide: When all 20 other recipe marks are present and the reserved legendary fish 1/honey jars 3/shrooms 3 are available, depart on a real trip and use the kitchen for the final dish. If already completed on Oct 14 or 15, skip this trip; otherwise repeat the same pantry/fishing method on the remaining Oct 17–23 free days as needed. Confirm 最強料理人 before returning to the main calendar. This is a contingency schedule, not an asserted mandatory date.

simpleJp: 10/24 【時間なし】：仮面・依り代の作成印を確認し、不足する白面・札を購入して作成する
enGuide: Check all four mask families lists (42 marks) and all vessel rows in More's special experiment menu. Use Brilehaven's rotating white mask stock and Virga talisman vendor; buy only deficits before ending the day. On Oct 25 recheck if needed. If a missing material is only found in the final dungeon, keep a deficit list and obtain it on Oct 26 before the boss. Do not mark 実験終了 as earned unless both lists are complete.

simpleJp: 10/24 夜・最終監査：全14人の支援ランクと各収集記録を見直す
enGuide: Calendar 10/24 夜・最終監査. Before the final free-action day audit every Follower R8, all remaining Gold Beetles (check all visited maps), missing recipe masks/vessels, collected books and debate records. If any item is locked by an earlier one-day event, acknowledge it cannot be recovered in current run; do not claim full 100% anyway.

simpleJp: 10/25 昼・自由：最終自由日までに残りの依頼・王の資質・支援者を終える
enGuide: Calendar 10/25 昼・自由. LAST FREE-ACTION DAY. Use remaining daytime slot only for missing activities that actually fit. Finish all remaining content before the ending sequence. A final same-day save at a functioning game save interface is recommended but is not a documented guide save checkpoint.

simpleJp: 10/25 監査：全14人の支援ランク8を確認する
enGuide: FINAL AUDIT before the last ordinary free-action day, October 25. Open the Followers menu and individually verify Gallica, Strohl, Hulkenberg, Heismay, Junah, Eupha, Basilio, Neuras, Maria, Catherina, Alonzo, Bardon, Brigitta, and More ALL read Rank 8. If any rank is missing, inspect the earlier quest/virtue/travel steps: discretionary Runner travel for Strohl/Hulkenberg/Heismay/Junah/Eupha/Basilio; Alonzo's Daturam conversation; Basilio's Vinca quest; Bardon's sandworm; Eupha's Hyperic; Neuras's relics plus Jin; More's Archetype trials. Prioritize the missing links before optional side content, and clear pending main-story dungeons early to avoid deadline-adjacent Follower lockouts.

simpleJp: 10/25 夜：支援者の別れの会話を確認する
enGuide: Optional final-day epilogue: On October 25, after verifying every Follower is already Rank 8, visit/talk to them again wherever the game makes them available for their farewell conversations and commemorative key items. These do not replace any missed bond ranks; finish the all-14 Rank 8 requirement first.

simpleJp: 10/26 物語：恐王星を進み、最後のボスの前に不足素材を回収する
enGuide: Explore the final dungeon and gather its chests/blue drops; if a mask or vessel remains, collect the required drop here before proceeding. The dated GamerB first-run walkthrough explicitly finishes all masks on October 26. Preserve a save before the final boss.

simpleJp: 10/26 【最終戦前・アカデメイア】：残りの仮面・依り代を作成し『実験終了』を確認する
enGuide: Use the final dungeon's Akademia access before the ending battle; complete every remaining recipe from the deficit list, verify the experiment achievement. Both halves must be complete. If all were made Oct 24, simply check the trophy/marks. No NG+ required for this objective.

simpleJp: 10/26 物語・最終決戦：最終作戦へ進んで本編をクリアする
enGuide: Calendar 10/26 物語・最終決戦. HARD FIRST-RUN TERMINAL: proceed with the final story battle only after October 25's all-content audit. NG+ (if desired) starts from a new playthrough after this first-run ending, never as an implicit continuation beyond the game ending.
